verdict.rationale: Lambda's docs say On-Demand Cloud instances, which are Linux VMs, accept direct SSH connections, and that you can add an existing SSH key to a workspace to connect. Root-level control is stated explicitly for Managed Slurm clusters ("sudo or root" on all nodes) and Private Cloud ("low-level access"). For single ODC instances it is implied by cloud-init launch configuration, alternate base images and the GPU Base image's "high degree of control". Missing for 10: an explicit statement of root/sudo access on single On-Demand instances, and independent hands-on confirmation of root access (the only community mention of SSH comes via an unofficial tool).
